protocol: DGX Spark release noise phase profile v1
purpose: Locate short-prefill latency clusters inside native compute, runtime locks, activation writes or downstream waits; no speed claim
hypothesis: The recurring ~20ms short-prefill latency step can be localized in existing per-request phase spans
prefix_policy: Unique fixed-width three-digit salt per condition position, repetition, shape and warm/measure; prompt token counts must match within each shape
diagnostics: Explicit --telemetry-level debug with SKIPPY_TELEMETRY_OTLP_FILE on both roles; one-second UTC GPU/host samples and pinned InferenceKit doctor. Require per-request prefill breakdown on leader and binary decode/message phase spans on worker. Instrumented timings cannot qualify performance.
analysis: Retain every request and trace span; correlate prefill chunk counts, stage0 compute, runtime-lock waits, forward writes and downstream waits with each request latency; do not infer GPU kernel time from CPU spans or hide dropped trace records

final_claim_target.round_count: Register from pilot before fresh main/main and main/PR acquisition; never extend a final run after observing its verdict

budget.authorization: Existing user-authorized exclusive lab qualification; no preemption or paid rental

build_policy.scope: Source-built CUDA qualification; not shipped dynamic package
